content:
ellie: Noticed weird Console heatmap blip last night for a tiny canary. looked like provisionals piled up but ledger has no commits and the heatmap stayed red for ~3m.

max: timeline? was this streaming + toolcall truncation or a sync call?

ellie: streaming. client reconnected mid-stream, router retried to another region. toolcall to /tools/kv_get was part of the flow. trace id t_9c11.

ravi: classic orphaned provisional effect. Console's heatmap aggregates provisional tokens by minute; without settle events it looks like sustained traffic. ops wakes up.

maya: do we even emit route info on provisional meter events today? I thought meter only had estimate + user + trace.

kevin: we emit: {estimate, trace, user, reason}. no route or provisional_key. logs: 
```
[router] t=t_9c11 fallback us-east-1 -> eu-west-2
[meter] provisional_add u=u-301 +44 tokens (streaming-est) trace=t_9c11
[ledger] no commit for t_9c11
```

ops-bot: filed PLAT-5550 "heatmap orphan provisional"

ellie: two UX asks: 1) make provisional heatmap not cause pager noise, 2) make it obvious which provisionals are orphaned vs in-flight.

max: proposal: keep heatmap realtime but color provisional cells with a hatch pattern and a tooltip that shows "provisional - route: <route> - age: <s>". also add a little trace link.

ravi: we also need infra changes so Console can correct older cells. meter should emit `provisional_key` and `route` and ledger emits `provisional_settle` with that key when commit happens. then Console can decrement the heatmap bucket.

maya: implementation detail: provisional_key must be stable across fast retries and model-swaps. suggest deterministic key = sha256(session_id || req_digest || toolcall_fp) and include attempt_seq when available.

kevin: caveat: some clients are stateless and won't pass session_id. router can synthesize provisional_key as hash(connection_fingerprint || client_ip || req_digest) but that's less precise. we should prefer client-supplied session id if present.

ellie: ok. what about toolcall truncation where toolcall payloads inflate estimates? we don't want a toolcall meta to double-count.

ravi: meter should attach a `source_tags` array: ["streaming", "tool:kv_get", "model:gptx-small"]. Console then allows toggling breakdown and a heatmap toggle to exclude tool-only provisional tokens.

maya: I'll open PRs: meter accepts provisional_key + source_tags + route. ledger hooks to persist provisional index and emit settle events. console subscribes and updates heatmap buckets.

max: ops wants an orphan detector that emits alert events when a provisional_key remains unsettled > 2m. we should increment a metric `provisional.orphan_count` and fire a P1 if many keys accumulate.

kevin: add a reconcile worker that scans provisionals >5m and marks them as reconciled with reason = "orphan_autoclose" and settled_tokens=0 (or best-effort) so the Console doesn't show stale red. reconcile emits audit log and `provisional.reconciled` metric.

ellie: UX: dashed/hatch heatmap band + hover shows route, trace, source_tags, age, and a link to the ledger settle event when available. orphaned cells should fade after reconcile.

ravi: tests: streaming + immediate retry + region fallback + toolcall truncated. verify provisional_key stable and Console bucket flips after settle/reconcile.

maya: PR plan: PR#9001 meter fields, PR#9002 ledger settle event, PR#9003 reconcile worker, PR#9004 console heatmap UX. I'll link the ticket.

ops-bot: linked PLAT-5550 -> PR #9001, PR #9002, PR #9003, PR #9004

ellie: thanks. can we also backfill last 6h of provisionals into the new index for postmortem? not blocking but useful.

kevin: agree. add a one-off backfill job that scans meter logs and writes provisional index records where possible. low-priority but helpful.

max: ok folks, prioritize meter + ledger + reconcile so Console can subscribe. UX can be staged after initial infra.

ellie: will follow up with screenshots once UX PR is up. keeping this thread open. :white_check_mark:
